assessment_summary.project_name: Axial Fan in Straight Duct — CFD Assessment
assessment_summary.cou_name: Predict swirl decay and static pressure recovery to support silencer placement and estimate shaft power for motor sizing at 1800 rpm without test data

evidence_keywords: Grid sensitivity (DP2, representative results):
Coarse: 3.1 million cells.
Fine: 12.7 million cells.
Grid refinement from medium to fine changed Δp_s by −1.1%
No formal error extrapolation was applied.
Residual behavior: Continuity and momentum residuals targeted below 1e−4
pseudo-transient under-relaxation
flattened before residual criteria
iterations were extended 200–400 cycles
Checks on Model Robustness
reduce the likelihood that the results hinge on arbitrary numerical choices
Limitations and Next Steps
is not intended to serve as a definitive characterization
SST k–ω was chosen
the realizable k–ε model was run
Δp_s: 178 Pa (−4.8% relative to SST).
Swirl at 1D: 18.9° (+10.5% relative to SST).
SST was retained.
Inlet: Volumetric flowrate boundary set to the duty flow
Turbulence at the inlet specified as intensity 5% with turbulent length scale 0.07D.
Surface roughness was not modeled; walls were treated as hydraulically smooth.
fillets and chamfers <1 mm were suppressed.
The fan tip clearance is 1.1 mm
